title: Clipped: langurs grooming, and who gets groomed most

scenes.headline: Grooming follows the troop's pecking order
scenes.body: Groups range from 2 to over 100 members.

caption:
Grooming isn't just cleaning. It's politics.

Hanuman langurs eat mostly leaves (about half their diet) and live from Kashmir and Nepal south to Sri Lanka, often close to people.

Source: Animal Diversity Web.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
